```{r}
#| echo: TRUE
#| warning: FALSE
#| eval: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| include: TRUE

set.seed(2026)

# Split by writer: 12 for training, 4 for validation, 4 for testing (unseen writers)
persons   <- sample(1:20)
train_ids <- which(meta$person_id %in% persons[1:12])
valid_ids <- which(meta$person_id %in% persons[13:16])
test_ids  <- which(meta$person_id %in% persons[17:20])

# Build n pairs: half same writer, half different writer.
# Each pair has the same digit and different sessions.
make_pairs <- function(ids, n) {
  a <- sample(ids, n, replace = TRUE)
  b <- vapply(a, function(i) {
    same <- runif(1) < .5
    pool <- ids[meta$digit[ids] == meta$digit[i] &                    # same digit
                meta$session[ids] != meta$session[i] &                # different session
                (meta$person_id[ids] == meta$person_id[i]) == same]   # same or different writer
    sample(pool, 1)
  }, integer(1))
  cbind(a, b)
}

# Turn pairs into model inputs; y = 1 if same writer, 0 otherwise
make_batch <- function(p) {
  list(
    left  = d$images[p[, 1], , , , drop = FALSE] / 255,
    right = d$images[p[, 2], , , , drop = FALSE] / 255,
    y     = matrix(as.numeric(meta$person_id[p[, 1]] == meta$person_id[p[, 2]]), ncol = 1),
    digit = meta$digit[p[, 1]]
  )
}

train <- make_batch(make_pairs(train_ids, 6000))
valid <- make_batch(make_pairs(valid_ids, 2000))
```

```{r}
#| echo: TRUE
#| warning: FALSE
#| eval: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| include: TRUE


# Shared encoder: maps one image to a 16-dimensional embedding
image <- layer_input(shape = c(28, 28, 1))
z <- image |>
  layer_conv_2d(16, 3, activation = "relu") |>
  layer_max_pooling_2d(2) |>
  layer_conv_2d(32, 3, activation = "relu") |>
  layer_max_pooling_2d(2) |>
  layer_flatten() |>                  # keeps position and size information
  layer_dropout(0.1) |>
  layer_dense(16)
encoder <- keras_model(image, z)

# Siamese network: the same encoder is applied to both images
a <- layer_input(shape = c(28, 28, 1))
b <- layer_input(shape = c(28, 28, 1))
distance <- list(encoder(a), encoder(b)) |>
  layer_lambda(f = function(z) {
    op_sqrt(op_sum(op_square(z[[1]] - z[[2]]), axis = 2, keepdims = TRUE) + 1e-7)
  })
siamese <- keras_model(list(a, b), distance)

# Contrastive loss: same writer pulled together, different writers pushed beyond a margin of 1
contrastive_loss <- function(y, d) {
  y <- op_cast(y, "float32")
  op_mean(y * op_square(d) + (1 - y) * op_square(op_maximum(1 - d, 0)))
}

# Pair accuracy for monitoring: predict "same writer" when the distance is below 0.5
pair_accuracy <- custom_metric("pair_accuracy", function(y_true, y_pred) {
  y_true <- op_cast(y_true, "float32")
  same   <- op_cast(op_less(y_pred, 0.5), "float32")
  op_mean(op_cast(op_equal(same, y_true), "float32"))
})

siamese |> compile(
  optimizer = optimizer_adam(0.0003),
  loss = contrastive_loss,
  metrics = list(pair_accuracy)
)

# Train; validation uses pairs from unseen writers
history_s <- siamese |> fit(
  list(train$left, train$right), train$y,
  validation_data = list(list(valid$left, valid$right), valid$y),
  epochs = 10, batch_size = 32
)
```
